# 💎 ClusterOreMiner

**Efficient mining at your fingertips!**

Tired of mining one block at a time? **ClusterOreMiner** is a lightweight, performance-friendly that allows you to harvest entire veins of connected ores instantly. Whether you're deep in the caves or mining in the Nether, this mod saves you time and effort while keeping the vanilla experience balanced.

---

## ✨ Features

* **Smart Cluster Mining:** Automatically detects and mines all connected ore blocks of the same type using a fast BFS (Breadth-First Search) algorithm.
* **Durability:** Mining a cluster consumes tool durability for every block mined.

* **Enchantment Support:** Fully compatible with **Fortune** (more drops!) and **Silk Touch** (get the ore block itself).
